hero.headline: Everything for sale near you, in one feed.
hero.subheadline: Shopi is where people post what they are selling and you find it by scrolling — cars, clothes, phones, furniture, fresh farm produce. See it, message the seller, agree, done.

features.headline: Find it. Message the seller. Close the deal.

scroll.title: You scroll, the product finds you
scroll.body: No searching for the right words. Sellers post short videos and photos of what they have. You just scroll your local feed and discover things you didn't even know to look for.

message.title: See it, message, agree
message.body: No cart. No checkout. No middleman. When something catches your eye, tap to chat with the seller, ask your questions and agree on price and pickup on your own terms.

local.title: The seller next to you, finally visible
local.body: The farmer in Kiambu. The phone dealer in town. The lady selling furniture down the road. They are all here — and now buyers across the country can find them.

ai.title: Just tell Shopi what you want
ai.body: Open Explore and ask in plain words: "black Mazda Demio, 2015, under 1 million, in Meru." Shopi searches, compares and recommends. Need more? It can ask the seller for you.

tiktok.title: Post on Shopi, get seen on TikTok too
tiktok.body: Connect your TikTok and choose to let your Shopi post auto-publish there, with the first comment linking back to your product. You post once and pull buyers from both — no posting twice.

free.title: Free, and it stays free to use
free.body: No fees to post. No commission on your sale. Shopi does not take a cut and does not hold your money. You and the buyer talk directly and keep everything between you.

howItWorks.headline: Scroll. Message. Agree. That is the whole thing.

1.title: Open the feed
1.body: No long forms to start looking. Pick what you are into — cars, phones, fashion, farm produce — and your local feed is ready in seconds.

2.title: Scroll what is near you
2.body: Watch real videos and photos from real sellers around you. Every post is something for sale, tagged with a location and a price.

3.title: Message the seller
3.body: Like it? Tap to chat directly. Ask questions, agree on the price, arrange pickup or delivery. No middleman, no commission.

4.title: Selling? Just post
4.body: Take a video of what you are selling, add a price and a location, and post. Buyers find you while scrolling, and message you straight away.

audience.headline: Anyone buying or selling near them.

buyers.title: Stop searching. Start discovering.
buyers.body: Forget typing into a search bar and hoping. Your feed shows you real products from real sellers around you, and you message anyone directly the moment you see something you want.

sellers.title: Your phone is your shop.
sellers.body: Take a short video, add a price and your location, and post. Buyers find you while scrolling and message you directly. No website, no ad budget, no commission taken from your sale.

testimonials.headline: Built for the way Kenya already buys and sells.

download.headline: What you are looking for is already on the feed.
download.body: Sellers near you are posting right now. Open the feed, find what you need, and message the seller directly. No fees, no checkout, no account needed to start looking.

footer.tagline: Kenya's social marketplace. Discover it, message the seller, done.

support.agentSubtitle: Usually replies in a few minutes
support.greeting: Hi there, I'm Amina from the Shopi support team. How can I help you today?
support.autoReply: Thanks for reaching out! Our team has received your message and will reply shortly.
